newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Outperform Canada again.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Outperform Canada again.

text.p: Australian bond yields showed only minor movements against the U.S., but continued to outperform Canadian debt.

U.S. Treasuries showed modest price gains after a fall in the prices component in the March NAPM index, which helped to negate the shock of a rise to 55.0 in the overall index, its highest level since February 1995.

The local market generally followed the U.S. move in the absence of any local data until Friday's February retail trade and building approvals, but even the reaction to them could be limited with the key U.S. non-farm payrolls report for March due later that day.

Meanwhile, Canadian bonds continued to suffer at the hands of a weakening currency, nearing two-year lows against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday, amid concerns that the Federal Reserve will tighten policy again and put pressure on the Bank of Canada to follow suit.
New Zealand bonds underperformed in generally slow trading.
